contacts.job_title: Area Sales Manager & Health Care Advisor

company.name: Wholefoods Wholesale
company.distributes: Natural and health foods, snacks, chocolate, supplements, body care; over 8,000 lines.
company.channels_supplied: Health stores, pharmacies and grocery; its site names Holland & Barrett, Boots, SuperValu, Dunnes Stores, Tesco and Centra; 2,500+ retail points.
company.sf_brands_carried: Booja Booja, Deliciously Ella, Biona, Love Corn, Rude Health. Its site also lists 'Lillys', described as sugar-free confectionery; identity not verified.
company.fit_rationale: Ireland's largest natural products wholesaler, based in Dublin 10 and part of the Total Produce (Dole) consumer health division. It reaches the health store and pharmacy channels where sugar-free confectionery sells best. Check whether the Lillys line overlaps with Diablo before pitching.

company.name: Avoca
company.distributes: Food markets, confectionery and gifting, cafes, clothing and homeware.
company.channels_supplied: Avoca stores and food markets in Dublin and Wicklow; owned by Aramark since 2015.
company.fit_rationale: Premium gifting destination where boxed chocolate sells well, but the food range leans heavily to own label and Irish artisan suppliers. Store list and head office town were not confirmed from its site, so treat details as provisional.

company.name: Circle K Ireland
company.distributes: Forecourt convenience: confectionery, snacks, food to go, drinks.
company.channels_supplied: About 420 service stations on the island of Ireland (356 Republic sites in the 2024 fuel report), many in Dublin.
company.fit_rationale: Largest forecourt network in Ireland, where impulse confectionery is a core category. Space is tight and dominated by major brands, so a small sugar-free bay or till-point trial is the realistic ask. Head office city is my understanding and not confirmed in the sources.

company.name: Dunnes Stores
company.distributes: Full grocery including confectionery, biscuits, spreads and free-from, plus textiles and homeware.
company.channels_supplied: 118 stores in the Republic of Ireland with a dense Dublin estate, and online grocery at dunnesstoresgrocery.com.
company.sf_brands_carried: Listed Free'ist sugar-free jellies in 2018 according to trade press; current range not verified.
company.fit_rationale: Largest grocer in Ireland by share (about 25%) with 118 stores and head office in Dublin 2. It already hosts Nourish health concessions and has listed sugar-free confectionery before, so the category is understood. No public supplier portal was found, so approach is through the confectionery buying team.

company.name: Euro Food Brands Ireland
company.based_out_of: Northampton, United Kingdom (Irish operation in Dublin)
company.distributes: Imported ambient food brands: confectionery, biscuits, world foods, meal solutions and a 'Free From & Wellbeing' category.
company.channels_supplied: Dunnes Stores, Tesco Ireland, SuperValu, Centra, Musgrave MarketPlace, Circle K, Spar, Mace, Londis, Value Centre, Stonehouse, Gala, Costcutter and Applegreen.
company.sf_brands_carried: Loacker, Hershey, Reese's, Galaxy Vegan, Yogi Tea; no sugar-free confectionery brand identified.
company.fit_rationale: Official Irish distributor for Hershey and Loacker with an Irish account team, field sales and a dedicated Irish warehouse partner. It gives named access to every major Irish grocery and convenience banner and has no visible sugar-free competitor.

company.name: Mr Price Branded Bargains
company.distributes: Discount variety: grocery, sweets, chocolate, crisps and snacks, household and toys.
company.channels_supplied: Own discount stores across Ireland (39 reported in 2017, more now; current count not verified) and online at mrprice.online.
company.fit_rationale: Has an open Suppliers page stating all suppliers are welcome, with a buying office in Tallaght and one in Manchester for UK and overseas suppliers. Branded confectionery is a core category, so it suits volume lines and promotional packs. Head office location is inferred from the Dublin buying office.

company.name: Nourish
company.distributes: Health foods, wholefoods, chocolate and sweet snacks, supplements, natural skincare.
company.channels_supplied: Own health stores (22 listed, 14 of them in Dublin), concessions inside Dunnes Stores and nourish.ie online.
company.sf_brands_carried: Has a Chocolate and Sweet Snacks category; specific sugar-free brands could not be read from the site and Diablo did not appear in the pages checked.
company.fit_rationale: Largest Dublin-centred health store chain with 14 Dublin stores out of 22 and a central buying function. Health-led shoppers and a dedicated sweet snacks category make a no-added-sugar range a natural listing, and the Dunnes concessions add reach.

company.name: Richmond Marketing
company.distributes: Premium drinks, snacks, chocolate and beauty brands across Ireland and Northern Ireland.
company.channels_supplied: All key retail channels with particular strength in convenience and forecourt, plus large format grocery.
company.sf_brands_carried: Fulfil protein bars (low sugar), Tony's Chocolonely, Ritter Sport, VIT-HIT; no sugar-free chocolate brand.
company.fit_rationale: Citywest distributor that built Fulfil in Irish convenience and was appointed exclusive Irish distributor for Ritter Sport in 2025. It is strong in chocolate and better-for-you impulse, though Ritter Sport and Tony's may limit appetite for another chocolate brand.

company.name: Shelton Distributors
company.distributes: Specialist confectionery and snacking distributor with 40+ brands: sugar confectionery, chocolate, toffee, protein bars, novelties.
company.channels_supplied: Symbol groups, convenience, forecourts, independents, foodservice and leisure; its site names Gala, Barry Group, BWG, Musgrave, Carrolls, Lidl, Woodie's, Aramark and Compass. Over 2,000 customers.
company.sf_brands_carried: Sante healthier options and Go On protein bars, Hamlet and Belfine chocolate, plus a 'Free From' store section. No dedicated sugar-free chocolate brand seen.
company.fit_rationale: Family-run confectionery specialist in Co. Dublin that already imports European brands (Trolli, PEZ, Zaini, Look-O-Look, Hamlet) with its own fleet. It has a healthier-options gap that a full sugar-free range would fill and all-island coverage since a 2024 acquisition.

company.name: United Drug
company.distributes: Pharmaceutical wholesale plus a consumer division for over-the-counter medicines, cosmetics and fragrances.
company.channels_supplied: Pharmacies, hospitals, nursing homes and GPs across Ireland with twice-daily delivery.
company.fit_rationale: The largest pharmacy wholesaler in Ireland, part of the PHOENIX group, and the second pharmacy route after Uniphar. Food and confectionery are not confirmed in its consumer range, so fit depends on a pharmacy-led pitch.
